svg.title: OpenGCMC algorithmic architecture
svg.desc: Editable scientific schema: compile reusable molecular context; correct pore-biased CBMC proposals with inverse proposal density and reverse retracing; batch energy evaluations while advancing each Markov state sequentially. Independent native CPU replicas share immutable framework context. Energy fields, not native neighbor tables, are persisted to disk.

g.inkscape:label: b · Corrected pore-biased CBMC
g.text: Bias the search, preserve the ensemble

g.inkscape:label: c · Candidate concurrency and state reuse
g.text: Parallel energy work, sequential state updates
Reject → reuse cache | Accept → rebuild when needed
